title: DeepMILO: a deep learning approach to predict the impact of non-coding sequence variants on 3D chromatin structure
summary: This method paper reports a specific cancer-genomics result (recurrent predicted loop disruption and association with BCL2/MYC expression), supported by learned sequence modeling and genomic expression analysis. Keep associations and predictions provisional. Methods/Results: CNN/RNN learn DNA sequence features for CTCF anchor/orientation and loop predictions. Test AUPRC varies by negative set (0.684 hardest); application to WGS of 1,834 patients across 12 cancer types predicts 672 insulator loops disrupted in ≥10% of patients; variants at anchors associated with BCL2/MYC upregulation in malignant lymphoma. Association/predictions computational, with validation on published loop datasets/deletion examples; does not prove causal mechanism.
